summary: Blocked on two independent gates. (1) Cannot fast-forward primary: `git merge-base --is-ancestor origin/master bd80ad0c` exits 1; merge-base is f18d387, origin/master 8626b42 has 44 commits not reachable from bd80ad0c, while bd80ad0c has one commit (the examples/eval/langfuse.rs + docs/EVALUATION.md langfuse retry/idempotency change) absent from master. Required: rebase the change onto current master and resubmit. (2) Configured check `check` (`./scripts/check`) exits 101 at the exact revision: `cargo fmt --check` passes, but `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` fails with clippy::chunks_exact_to_as_chunks at src/hud.rs:1130 and src/hud.rs:2337 (unchanged legacy code absent from current master; stable cargo/rustc 1.98.1), so `cargo test` never runs in the gate. The diff itself reads as a coherent retry+upsert-idempotency change and its example tests pass in isolation (`cargo test --example eval`: 31 passed), but Checks are not green and the SHA cannot fast-forward the primary.
